name: footval
description: Independent football (soccer) player valuations: FootVal's own estimated transfer value next to the market value, with the factors behind the gap, plus scouting filters and rankings, live scores, match centres, league tables, team fixtures, season stat leaders and transfer news. 15 read-only tools. Hosted remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth, with a Google account), or send a personal API key from https://footval.com/en/mcp as an Authorization Bearer header. Every account has a free daily allowance of tool calls.

FOOTVAL_API_KEY.description: Personal FootVal API key (starts with fvk_) from the account section of https://footval.com/en/mcp. Only needed for clients that cannot sign in with OAuth.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. Your MCP client opens footval.com for a one-time sign-in with a Google account; no API key is needed for the sign-in flow.

http-api-key.description: The same server with a personal API key, for clients that cannot open a sign-in window.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: A player's FootVal value next to the market value, the gap and its verdict, the factor breakdown, value history, season stats, transfers, contract and similar players.

tools.name: compare_players
tools.description: Two to four players side by side: values, age, position, performance percentile, every valuation factor and last-season output.

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Scout by league, club, nation, position, age, preferred foot and value range; sort by value, market value, undervalued, overvalued, youth, performance or recent rise.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Most valuable, most undervalued or overvalued (EUR 10M+), biggest risers or fallers, and wonderkids (21 and under).

tools.name: search_football
tools.description: Find players, clubs, leagues and national teams by name, accents optional.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: Every league FootVal values, with strength tier, clubs, players and total squad value.

tools.name: get_league
tools.description: A league's clubs ranked by squad value (FootVal vs market) and its most valuable players.

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: A club's squad with every player's FootVal value, market value and the gap, plus totals.

tools.name: get_national_team
tools.description: The strongest 26-player squad for a nation (3 GK / 8 DF / 8 MF / 7 FW by value).

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Live scores, results and fixtures for any date across leagues, European and domestic cups and national-team tournaments.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match in depth: score, event timeline, team statistics and line-ups with ratings.

tools.name: get_team_fixtures
tools.description: A club's or national team's next or most recent matches.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: A competition's table with form and qualification or relegation zones.

tools.name: get_stat_leaders
tools.description: Season leaderboards (goals, assists, goals plus assists, minutes, appearances) per competition, across national-team competitions, or across all competitions combined.

tools.name: get_transfer_news
tools.description: Latest confirmed transfers and rumours with fees, clubs, reliability and dates.

examples.title: Player value
examples.description: What a player is worth and why FootVal disagrees with the market
examples.prompt: What is Lamine Yamal really worth, and why?

examples.prompt: Who are the most undervalued players in the Premier League?
